title: Muddy Feet
sentences: When rain starts to pour, there is nothing more sweet,
Than a day of splish-sploshing with wet muddy feet.
When I woke, my feet were clean,
Spotless with a sparkling sheen.
First thing’s first, I put on socks.
Then my shoes, to walk on rocks.
Shoes are great for tricky jumps,
Over puddles, logs, or stumps.
Once I laid them on the floor,
Off I went- out the door.
Just before I reached the grass,
Down came raindrops, falling fast.
They weren’t cold- I didn’t mind.
Warm rain is my favorite kind.
Hitting dirt, it mished and moshed.
Pretty soon it splished and sploshed.
The ground was wet and getting wetter.
Dirt is nice but mud is better.
Cause nothing ever will compete,
With hopping round on muddy feet.
I like grass between my toes,
Even though it stains my clothes.
I like sand, from on the beach.
It gets in places hard to reach.
With leaves I like them by the pile.
Never fails to make me smile.
But nothing’s even half as sweet,
As hopping round with muddy feet.
So that is why my shoes came off.
And that is why I caught a cough.
All stuffed up and feeling ill.
I wonder if my mother will,
Clean the dirt that’s on my sheet,
From laying here with muddy feet.

when.meaning: Palavra usada para indicar o momento em que algo acontece ('quando').
examples: When it rains, I stay inside.

rain.meaning: Água que cai das nuvens; chuva.
examples: We stayed inside because of the rain.

starts.meaning: Começa; forma do verbo 'to start' (começar) na terceira pessoa do singular.

to.meaning: Preposição que indica direção, destino ou o infinitivo de um verbo ('para', 'a').

pour.meaning: Cair com força (falando de chuva) ou despejar um líquido.
examples: She poured the milk into the glass.

there.meaning: Advérbio de lugar; também usado em 'there is/are' para indicar existência.
examples: There is nothing more fun than this.

is.meaning: Forma do verbo 'to be' (ser/estar) na terceira pessoa do singular.
examples: There is a dog in the yard.

nothing.meaning: Nenhuma coisa; indica ausência total de algo.
examples: There is nothing in the box.

more.meaning: Em maior quantidade ou grau; mais.
examples: This is more fun than that.

sweet.meaning: Agradável ou doce; algo muito bom ou gostoso.

than.meaning: Palavra usada em comparações, equivalente a 'do que'.

examples: I'll see you in two days.

of.meaning: Preposição que indica posse, origem ou parte de algo ('de').

splish-sploshing.meaning: Palavra inventada e divertida que imita o som de pisar ou brincar na lama/água; uma onomatopeia.
examples: The kids went splish-sploshing through the puddles.
We spent the afternoon splish-sploshing in the rain.

with.meaning: Preposição que indica companhia ou instrumento ('com').

wet.meaning: Molhado; coberto ou encharcado de água.
examples: The grass is wet after the rain.

muddy.meaning: Coberto de lama; sujo de barro.
examples: We walked on a muddy path.

feet.meaning: Plural de 'foot' (pé); parte do corpo usada para andar.

i.meaning: Pronome pessoal de primeira pessoa do singular ('eu').

examples: She woke when the alarm rang.

clean.meaning: Limpo, sem sujeira; também pode significar 'limpar' como verbo.
examples: I need to clean my shoes.
Her eyes were sparkling with joy.

sheen.meaning: Brilho suave na superfície de algo.
examples: The floor had a nice sheen.
Her hair had a healthy sheen.

first.meaning: Que vem antes de todos os outros; primeiro.
examples: This is my first time here.

thing's.meaning: Contração informal de 'thing is' (a coisa é), usada aqui na expressão 'first thing's first' (primeiro, o mais importante primeiro).

examples: I put the book on the table.

on.meaning: Preposição que indica posição em cima de algo, ou o ato de vestir algo ('em cima de', 'vestir').
examples: The cup is on the table.

socks.meaning: Peça de roupa usada nos pés, dentro do sapato; meias.
examples: I wear warm socks in winter.
First we eat, then we play.
I got dressed, then left the house.
We walk to school every day.
The path was covered with rocks.

are.meaning: Forma do verbo 'to be' para 'you/we/they' no presente.

for.meaning: Preposição que indica finalidade, destinatário ou motivo ('para').

tricky.meaning: Difícil de fazer; que exige cuidado ou habilidade.
examples: Jumping over the puddle was tricky.
He did three jumps in a row.
The cat jumped over the fence.

puddles.meaning: Poças de água, geralmente formadas pela chuva.
examples: There were puddles all over the street.

logs.meaning: Troncos de árvore cortados; plural de 'log'.
examples: He chopped the logs for the fire.

stumps.meaning: Tocos de árvore; o que resta de uma árvore cortada; plural de 'stump'.
examples: The field was full of old stumps.
Once I finish, I'll call you.

laid.meaning: Passado do verbo 'to lay' (colocar algo deitado/apoiado).
examples: She laid the baby in the crib.
He laid his coat on the chair.

them.meaning: Pronome pessoal de terceira pessoa do plural, usado como objeto ('eles/elas', 'os/as').

floor.meaning: Chão; parte inferior de um ambiente.
examples: The toy is on the floor.

off.meaning: Longe de, para fora de, ou desligado.

out.meaning: Para fora; do lado de fora.

door.meaning: Porta; entrada de uma casa ou cômodo.

just.meaning: Apenas, exatamente, ou há pouco tempo.

examples: I saw her before the rain started.

reached.meaning: Passado do verbo 'to reach' (alcançar, chegar a).

grass.meaning: Grama; planta verde que cobre o chão.

examples: He sat down on the chair.
I could hear the raindrops on the roof.

falling.meaning: Caindo; particípio presente do verbo 'to fall'.

they.meaning: Pronome pessoal de terceira pessoa do plural ('eles/elas').

didn't.meaning: Contração de 'did not' (não fez / não [verbo no passado]).

examples: Do you mind if I sit here?

favorite.meaning: Preferido; o que se gosta mais.

examples: What kind of music do you like?

hitting.meaning: Batendo; particípio presente do verbo 'to hit'.
examples: The rain was hitting the window.
His hands were covered in dirt.
Clean the dirt off your shoes.

it.meaning: Pronome usado para objetos, animais ou ideias ('ele/ela', referindo-se a algo neutro).

mished.meaning: Palavra inventada que imita o som da lama sendo pisada; onomatopeia informal (parecida com 'squelched').
examples: The mud mished under his boots.

and.meaning: Conjunção que une ideias ou elementos ('e').

moshed.meaning: Palavra inventada que imita o som da lama sendo pisada com força; onomatopeia informal.
examples: The thick mud moshed under his feet.
It moshed as he jumped in.
Pretty soon it started to rain.
Pretty soon it started to rain.

splished.meaning: Palavra inventada que imita o som de respingar na lama ou água; variação de 'splashed'.
examples: The water splished around his boots.
It splished and sploshed in the mud.

sploshed.meaning: Palavra inventada que imita o som de algo caindo ou se mexendo na lama/água.

getting.meaning: Ficando, tornando-se; particípio presente do verbo 'to get'.

examples: The ground got wetter and wetter.
My socks are wetter than my shoes.
Dirt is nice, but mud is better.
Dirt is nice but mud is better.

mud.meaning: Lama; mistura de terra e água.
examples: The pig rolled in the mud.
My boots are covered in mud.
This book is better than that one.
He says mud is better than dirt.
I stayed home 'cause it was raining.
Cause nothing is better than this.
Have you ever been to Brazil?
Nothing will ever compete with this.

will.meaning: Verbo auxiliar usado para o futuro ('vai/irá').

compete.meaning: Competir; disputar algo com outra pessoa ou coisa.
examples: The two teams will compete tomorrow.

hopping.meaning: Pulando (em um pé só ou aos saltinhos); particípio presente do verbo 'to hop'.
examples: The rabbit was hopping in the yard.
He was hopping around in the mud.

round.meaning: Ao redor, em círculo; usado aqui como sinônimo informal de 'around'.

like.meaning: Gostar de algo, ou usado para comparação ('como').

between.meaning: No meio de duas coisas; entre.
examples: The ball is between the chairs.

even.meaning: Até mesmo; usado para enfatizar algo surpreendente.
examples: Even though it rained, we went out.
Even though it stains my clothes, I like it.
It was cold, though she didn't mind.

stains.meaning: Mancha ou suja algo; forma do verbo 'to stain' (manchar) na terceira pessoa.
examples: Coffee stains are hard to remove.
I need to buy new clothes.

sand.meaning: Areia; encontrada em praias e desertos.
examples: The sand was warm on the beach.
Kids love playing in the sand.

from.meaning: Preposição que indica origem ou procedência ('de', 'a partir de').
examples: I like sand from the beach.

beach.meaning: Praia; faixa de areia à beira-mar.
examples: We spent the day at the beach.
The beach was crowded in summer.

gets.meaning: Obtém, consegue, ou torna-se; forma do verbo 'to get' na terceira pessoa.
examples: Sand gets in places hard to reach.

in.meaning: Preposição que indica localização interna ('dentro de', 'em').
examples: The sand gets in my shoes.
Sand gets in places hard to reach.

reach.meaning: Alcançar; chegar a um lugar ou objeto.
examples: I can't reach the top shelf.
Sand gets in places hard to reach.
The leaves fell from the tree.
I like jumping in piles of leaves.

by.meaning: Perto de, ou por meio de; preposição.
examples: I like leaves by the pile.
There was a pile of leaves.
He made a pile of clothes.
It never fails to make me smile.

fails.meaning: Falha; não consegue fazer algo; forma do verbo 'to fail'.
examples: He never fails to make me laugh.
The plan fails if it rains.

make.meaning: Fazer, criar, ou causar que algo aconteça.
examples: It never fails to make me smile.

me.meaning: Pronome pessoal de primeira pessoa, usado como objeto ('mim', 'me').

smile.meaning: Sorriso; ou o ato de sorrir.
examples: She gave me a big smile.

half.meaning: Metade; uma das duas partes iguais de algo.
examples: This isn't even half as sweet.
She ate half of the cake.
Nothing is as sweet as this.
He is as tall as his brother.
So that is why my shoes came off.

that.meaning: Pronome/conjunção usado para indicar algo específico ('aquele/aquilo', 'que').
examples: I know that you like mud.

why.meaning: Por quê; usado para perguntar ou explicar uma razão.
examples: That is why my shoes came off.

caught.meaning: Passado do verbo 'to catch' (pegar, contrair uma doença).

examples: I caught a cough from playing in the rain.
All stuffed up and feeling ill.

stuffed.meaning: Entupido, congestionado (geralmente referindo-se ao nariz quando resfriado).
examples: I'm all stuffed up with a cold.

up.meaning: Para cima; também usado em expressões como 'stuffed up'.
examples: All stuffed up and feeling ill.

feeling.meaning: Sentindo-se; particípio presente do verbo 'to feel'.

examples: He felt ill after the rain.
She was too ill to go to school.
I wonder if it will rain.
She wondered what he was thinking.

if.meaning: Se; usado para introduzir uma condição.
examples: I wonder if my mother will clean it.
I'll go if it stops raining.
I wonder if my mother will understand.
That's why I love the rain.

sheet.meaning: Lençol; peça de tecido usada na cama.
examples: There was mud on my sheet.

laying.meaning: Deitando, ficando deitado; particípio presente de 'to lay' (usado aqui no sentido informal de 'lying', deitar-se).
examples: I was laying here all day.
She is laying the baby down.
I was laying here with muddy feet.
